Power Up with Blanka
                                                           In collaboration with Capcom, the MWE Gold 1050
                                                           V2 SF6 Blanka brings newly optimized performance
                                                           to a Cooler Master classic with a green and yellow
                                                           lightning design inspired by Blanka from Street
                                                           Fighter 6.

                                                           This unit includes 80 Plus Gold certified efficiency,
                                                           fully modular cabling, a 140mm silent fan with a
                                                           zero RPM default mode, ATX 3.0 support, and a
                                                           durable 12VHPWR cable capable of providing 600W
                                                           per connector. With the V2, Cooler Master is
                                                           providing a highly efficient and reliable package that
                                                           showcases Blanka’s power.
